name: Christmas Party
summary: Invite your friends to enter this VR space specially crafted for Christmas. Together, you’ll find yourselves in a lifelike, intricately designed Christmas-themed house—from the spruce tree laden with ornaments to the cozy corners adorned with red velvet rugs, every detail captures the spirit of the season. You can unwind and soak in the gentle indoor lighting, watch the snowfall outside, feel the steady warmth of the fireplace, and admire the countless twinkling little decorations scattered throughout.
